title: Orders
subtitle: Data-plane view: orders flowing through Officer, their lifecycle events, and the resulting trades. Select an order row to see its event timeline and fills.

filter.advancedDescription: Set secondary order and trade filters. The list refreshes from the server with the active filter set.

notFound.title: Order not found
notFound.description: No order with ID {{externalId}} was found.

table.signedIndicator: This order has at least one signed event.

columnDescriptions.externalId: This column shows the immutable identifier supplied by the caller or generated by Officer.
columnDescriptions.account: This column shows the account that submitted the order or received the trade.
columnDescriptions.instrument: This column shows the base and quote assets traded by the row.
columnDescriptions.side: This column shows whether the row is a buy or sell flow.
columnDescriptions.amount: This column shows the submitted order amount and its amount kind.
columnDescriptions.price: This column shows the order limit price or the trade execution price.
columnDescriptions.status: This column shows the current order lifecycle status.
columnDescriptions.source: This column shows whether the row came from the panel, REST, MCP, or another source.
columnDescriptions.time: This column shows when the order or trade was recorded.
columnDescriptions.order: This column links a trade back to its parent order.
columnDescriptions.qty: This column shows the executed base-asset quantity.
columnDescriptions.lockPrice: This column shows the price used for funds locking when it differs from execution.
columnDescriptions.displayPrices: This column shows additional prices returned by the risk engine for operator review.

orders.title: No orders yet
orders.hint: Orders submitted through the panel, API, or MCP will appear here.

trades.title: No trades yet
trades.hint: Trades result from execution reports submitted against orders.

dialog.title: Add order
dialog.description: Add an order to evaluate it against the risk engine. This is an emulation — nothing is sent to any market. Without a price it is treated as a market order and may be rejected.
dialog.externalIdHint: Use your own unique ID when you need a stable order handle.
dialog.submitModeImmediateHelp: The trade already happened: record the fill in Officer now.
dialog.submitModeHoldHelp: Lock funds and wait for the post-trade report.
dialog.validationError: Account, instrument, and amount are required.

dialog.title: Submit execution report
dialog.description: Order {{orderExternalId}} - record a fill to emulate a partial or full execution.

statusHelp.submitted: Records the order as submitted to the venue. No trade, no balance change.
statusHelp.accepted: Records venue acceptance of the order. No trade, no balance change.
statusHelp.rejected: Closes the order as rejected. No trade, no balance change.
statusHelp.committed: Records the reservation as committed. No trade, no balance change.
statusHelp.rolled_back: Records the reservation as rolled back. No trade, no balance change.
statusHelp.filled: Settles the order's full remaining quantity as one fill and closes it.
statusHelp.partially_filled: Settles part of the order's remaining quantity and leaves it open.
statusHelp.cancelled: Closes the order, releasing any still-open quantity. No trade.

dialog.force: Force: bypass the check that prevents reports on finalized orders
dialog.validationError: Quantity and price are required for a fill status.

hold.title: Held reservation
hold.description: This order is held. Confirm it to commit the reservation, or cancel it to roll the reservation back.
hold.force: Force: bypass Officer's safety checks and route straight to the engine

timeline.verifySigned: Reproduce and verify this event's signature

trades.empty: No fills recorded yet. Submit an execution report to create a trade.

panel.title: Reproduce and verify
panel.description: The exact artifacts a robot or agent received for this request, shown verbatim so you can copy them, verify the signature, or verify any pasted token.

repro.loadError: The reproduction bundle could not be loaded. {{message}}
repro.noAttestation: This event carries no persisted attestation, so there is nothing to reproduce.
repro.tokenNote: The exact base64url token the robot received. Primary copy.
repro.requestNote: The request bound in the attestation and the engine result it produced.
repro.responseNote: The exact API response, reconstructed by the same server serializer.
repro.signatureNote: The envelope signature and the public key resolved by this attestation's key id — which may be a rotated, non-active key.
repro.eventBodyNote: The event body, as GET /orders returns it.

verify.label: Verify signature
verify.note: Runs Ed25519 in your browser over the canonical bytes above, using the public key for this attestation's key id.
verify.validNote: Signature verified against the public key for this attestation's key id.
verify.invalidNote: Signature does not match. The token may have been altered.
verify.unsignedNote: No cryptographic signature — this event was attested under eSign-off.
verify.missingArtifacts: The canonical bytes or signature are missing from the bundle.
verify.snippetKeyNote: The public key is in raw-base64 form, resolved by this attestation's key id.
verify.pasteMalformed: The token could not be decoded as a signed attestation envelope.
verify.pasteNoKeyId: The token carries no key id, so its public key cannot be resolved.
verify.pasteUnknownKey: No public key is known for key id {{keyId}}.

paste.label: Token
paste.note: Paste any base64url envelope token. It is decoded in your browser; its key id resolves the public key to verify against.

breakdown.label: Human-readable breakdown
breakdown.readOnlyNote: Read only — not for copying or verification. Verify against the canonical bytes, never a reformatted copy.
